English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us Misleading videos shared on Israel-Iran war Misleading Following the missile attack by Iran on Israel, FactSeeker observed numerous videos and news reports being shared on social media. by Anonymous | October 3, 2024 Factseeker also identified that many of these shared videos and accompanying news reports are misleading. A video titled ‘The moment of Netanyahu’s escape’ is being circulated. However, this video was actually recorded on December 14, 2021, when Netanyahu rushed to vote in the Knesset. At that time, he was the opposition leader. The link related to this is attached here: https://www.hidabroot.org/article/1162572 Similarly, a video purportedly showing a missile attack on Israel’s capital, Tel Aviv, is being widely shared. However, this video is from an incident where an unmanned drone exploded in Moscow, a mishap documented by international media in 2023. The link related to this is attached here: https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-europe-66353931 Many such misleading videos are currently being widely shared on platforms like X and Facebook. Factseeker has confirmed that these videos are all old and are being shared in a way that misleads the public. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase?
